title: Allinement
summary: ALLI'NEMENT, noun [Latin linea.] A reducing to a line or to a square; a state of being in squares, in a line, or on a level; a line; a row.

inlines.v: ALLI'NEMENT, noun [Latin linea.] A reducing to a line or to a square; a state of being in squares, in a line, or on a level; a line; a row.
